rules.rationale: This is the guarded base equation of the trialPrime mathematical summary: once D has reached or passed N on the defined proof domain D >= 2, it defines the summary result to be the accumulated Boolean P.
This is the divisible-case recurrence defining trialPrime: for a candidate D in the remaining range that divides N, it advances to D + 1 with the accumulated summary value set to false.
This is the nondivisible-case recurrence defining trialPrime: for a candidate D in the remaining range that does not divide N, it advances to D + 1 while preserving the accumulated Boolean P.

This unguarded wrapper equation defines primeNat(N) as the initial trialPrime state with divisor 2 and initial Boolean N >= 2; it names the proof's primality summary rather than adding an independent fact.
